emilink.tooltip.batch_marked: §bBatch marked | Modifier + Right Drag to Unmark
emilink.tooltip.quick_craft: Use the BOM quick-craft button to craft this tree
emilink.tooltip.favorite_bom_quick_craft: Left-click to quick craft this BOM tree
emilink.configuration.title: EmiLink Config
emilink.config.general.debugMode.tooltip:
Print debug logs.
Also shows debug chat messages.
emilink.config.cache.cacheTTLMs.tooltip:
How long AE query results are kept.
Unit: milliseconds.
How long missing-item results are kept.
Unit: milliseconds.
emilink.config.cache.batchFlushMs.toolti:
How often AE batch queries are sent and how long priority refresh waits after a network transfer.
Unit: milliseconds.
emilink.config.emi_ui.wbFillInputGrid.to:
When Wrap as Book is on:
place the original output into an empty input slot.
emilink.config.emi_ui.enableDragFill.too: Drag EMI stacks into compatible search fields. Compatible fields are highlighted while dragging.
emilink.config.emi_ui.enableMobSeparator:
Move mob-related EMI index entries into a separated section.
Disable in large modpacks to reduce sidebar render cost.
emilink.config.emi_ui.bookmarkPriority.t:
When encoding processing patterns:
prefer items from EMI favorites.
Minimum favorite pages kept available.
Long MOB trees may still add temporary pages.
emilink.config.emi_ui.searchHistoryPosit:
OFF disables search history.
AUTO keeps the adaptive default.
ABOVE, LEFT, and RIGHT force the history beside the EMI search box.
emilink.config.emi_ui.enableCopyHoveredS:
When enabled, Ctrl+C over an EMI stack copies its id, such as minecraft:dirt.
Disabled by default to avoid conflicting with normal text copy.
emilink.config.emi_ui.enableFavoriteDrag: Modifier + left-drag toggles protection: protect all if any selection is unprotected; otherwise unprotect all.
emilink.config.emi_ui.favoriteDragSelect:
Modifier + left-drag toggles protection.
Protects unprotected selections or unprotects protected selections; press ESC to disable (OFF).
emilink.config.emi_ui.favoriteProtection:
RGB color for protected favorite outlines and the drag rectangle border.
Use six-digit hexadecimal, such as FFD700 or #FFD700.

Opacity for protected favorite outlines and the drag rectangle border.
Range: 0-255, where 0 is transparent and 255 is opaque.

RGB color for the drag-selection rectangle background.
Use six-digit hexadecimal, such as FFD700 or #FFD700.

Opacity for the drag-selection rectangle background.
Range: 0-255, where 0 is transparent and 255 is opaque.
emilink.config.emi_ui.enableBatchMark.to:
Modifier + right-drag marks sidebar stacks.
Dropping one marked stack onto a filter slot fills the remaining marks
into the following slots, in the order they were selected.
emilink.config.emi_ui.batchMarkBorderCol:
RGB color for batch-marked outlines and the drag rectangle border.
Use six-digit hexadecimal, such as 00C8FF or #00C8FF.
emilink.config.emi_ui.batchMarkBorderOpa:
Opacity for batch-marked outlines and the drag rectangle border.
Range: 0-255, where 0 is transparent and 255 is opaque.
emilink.config.emi_ui.batchMarkBackgroun:
RGB color for the batch-mark background.
Use six-digit hexadecimal, such as 00C8FF or #00C8FF.

Opacity for the batch-mark background.
Range: 0-255, where 0 is transparent and 255 is opaque.
emilink.config.emi_ui.enableBatchMarkFil:
Drop one marked stack onto a filter slot to fill the remaining
marks into the following slots.
Disabled: only the dropped slot is marked.
emilink.config.emi_ui.sharedEdgeSplit.to:
Draw a border shared by protection and batch marking half in
each colour, so both outlines connect.
Disabled: shared borders use the mark colour only.
emilink.config.ae_network.enableAeNetwor: Enabled by default. Reads AE stored and craftable states for EMI overlays and interactions. When disabled, no AE queries are sent and network information is hidden.
emilink.config.ae_network.enableNetworkB:
Show AE state on EMI stacks.
Bottom: stored count (k/m/g/t).
Top-right: cross when the item has a pattern.
emilink.config.ae_network.enableCraftabl:
Query craftability for the top-right cross.
Disable on large AE networks to show counts only.
emilink.config.ae_network.initialBadgeSc:
How many EMI stacks are queried immediately when opening an AE terminal.
Set to 0 to disable the initial scan.
emilink.config.ae_network.extractModifie:
Click EMI stacks to extract from network.
Click to rebind to any key or mouse button; press ESC to disable (OFF).
emilink.config.ae_network.enableAeDeposi:
Click the EMI sidebar with a carried item.
Requires a wireless terminal or open AE terminal.
emilink.config.ae_network.depositBatchMo:
Deposit all matching items.
Click to rebind to any key or mouse button; press ESC to disable (OFF).
emilink.config.quick_craft.enableQuickCr: Recursively execute the BOM tree and fill the workbench automatically.
emilink.config.quick_craft.batchesPerTic:
Maximum successful AE BOM batches submitted per client tick.
Range: 1-256. Higher values are faster but may increase burst menu packets.
emilink.config.inventory.enableBulkTrans:
Bulk transfer items in regular containers.
Disable if another mod conflicts.
emilink.config.inventory.enableDiscardMa:
Hover a slotted item, then press Ctrl+Shift+the vanilla drop key.
IPN locked slots are skipped.
emilink.config.general.enableDebugPacket:
Limit debug packet frequency.
Useful when testing noisy logs.
